Name: Mick Dundee
Description: Written by Chris Claremont and drawn by Rick Leonardi. The name clearly hearkens to the screen character Mick Dundee of the "Crocodile Dundee" franchise, though the characters are in no way related outside being from Australia. (The first movie had come out in 1986 with a sequel in 1988.)
